To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the correlation functions of the Toda field theory are described in terms of the conformal blocks and the conformal partial waves of the Liouville field theory.
the 4-point functions of conformal Toda theories are expressed in terms of the solutions to the Tzitzeica equation.
the 2D CFT correlation functions of Toda field theory can be represented as a sum over the set of the so called “minimal surfaces”.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following topics: 1.
the study of conformal Toda ﬁeld theory in two-dimensional spacetime, and the construction of its correlation functions in terms of conformal blocks.

the following problems: (i) the calculation of the conformal Toda theory correlation functions in the case of the arbitrary values of the coupling constants; (ii) the calculation of correlation functions in the Toda theory on the sphere and the torus; (iii) the calculation of conformal Toda correlators in the limit of large values of the coupling constant.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the correlation functions in the conformal Toda theory are expressed in terms of the hypergeometric functions with parameters depending on the spin and conformal weights of the operators involved in the correlation function, and the parameters of the theory.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have constructed the complete set of conformal correlation functions in the Toda field theory, which are the most complicated among conformal theories.
we have found the exact expression for the four-point functions of the conformal Toda theory.
we have found a new class of integrable models in 2D.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the conformal field theory (CFT) of the Toda field theory (TFT) is a very interesting object, which is the subject of this work.
the Toda field theory is the only integrable 2d QFT that is not a WZW model.
the correlation functions in conformal field theory can be calculated by the method of the integrable lattice models.
